_comment: Campus-system-specific values. Everything else in src/ is driven by these.
_icalEndpoint: Base URL of a deployed worker/ instance, e.g. https://better-cis-ical.<subdomain>.workers.dev. Prefills the subscription dialog; students can point at their own. Empty means the dialog asks for one.
_releaseFeed: Release API this build checks for updates, at most once a day. Its origin becomes a host permission. Empty disables update checking entirely — no request, no permission, no banner.
